Every trade, one crew

Why juggle five contractors?

Most jobs touch more than one trade — a kitchen needs plumbing and electrical, a boiler swap needs carpentry and masonry patching. A-Rai handles all of it in-house, so nothing waits on somebody else’s schedule. Every project starts with a free estimate.
